description: Defines the SensorInterface class and various sensor-related classes such as BaseSensor, HardwareSensor, VirtualSensor, RuntimeSensor, and ProximitySensor within the android namespace. It declares interfaces and classes for sensor processing, activation, batching, and management in the Android sensor service framework.

classes.name: SensorInterface
classes.description: Abstract interface for sensor operations, including processing events, activation, batching, and sensor info retrieval.

classes.name: BaseSensor
classes.description: Base class implementing SensorInterface, providing common sensor functionalities.

classes.name: HardwareSensor
classes.description: Represents a hardware sensor, extending BaseSensor with processing and control capabilities.

classes.name: VirtualSensor
classes.description: Represents a virtual sensor, extending BaseSensor, with a focus on virtual sensor fusion.

classes.name: RuntimeSensor
classes.description: Sensor with runtime configuration capabilities, including a callback interface for configuration changes.

classes.name: ProximitySensor
classes.description: Specialized hardware sensor for proximity detection, extending HardwareSensor.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Processes sensor events, implemented by subclasses.

methods.name: setDelay
methods.description: Sets the delay for sensor event reporting.

methods.name: batch
methods.description: Configures batching parameters for sensor events.

methods.name: isVirtual
methods.description: Indicates whether the sensor is virtual.
